## Checklist
- [ ] `make check` passes (syntax, whitespace guard, shellcheck)
- [ ] `make test` passes (bats) or the change is documented as untestable
- [ ] No existing command, flag, path or function was renamed or removed (or it is called out below)
- [ ] User-visible changes are listed in `CHANGELOG.md` under *Unreleased*
- [ ] Security-relevant change (sandbox, signatures, manifest parsing)? Explain the threat it addresses
